the Big Five personality traits are positively related to job performance and negatively related to job stress.
the relationship of personality traits and ethical ideologies with job outcomes is not a linear one.

the mediating role of ethical ideology in the Big Five personality traits-job outcomes relationship, and the findings are discussed in detail.
the relationship between Big Five personality traits, ethical ideology, and job outcomes in Pakistan.
the relationship between Big Five personality traits with ethical ideology and its impact on job outcomes.

this study has contributed to the existing body of knowledge of OB literature in two ways: (i) by providing empirical evidence for a theoretical model that explains the mediating role of ethical ideology in the relationship between personality and job outcomes; (ii) by adding empirical evidence from a unique context (Pakistan).
this study has provided a theoretical framework for the relationship between personality, ethical ideology, and job outcomes in the workplace.
the Big Five personality traits are significantly related to ethical ideology, which in turn significantly predicts job outcomes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Big Five personality traits have different effects on job outcomes through different mediating mechanisms.
this study provides a new conceptual framework to understand how personality traits and ethical ideologies of individuals determine the job outcomes.
the present work is the first study to empirically test the relationship of the Big Five personality traits with ethical ideologies and their mediating effects on job outcomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the personality of an individual is not the only determinant of job outcomes; the personality trait is moderated by ethical ideology which is a function of socialization and upbringing.
personality and job outcomes are not directly related but mediated by ethical ideology.
the Big Five traits of personality are not only associated with ethical ideology but they also determine the outcomes of ethical ideology.
